title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
summary: The summary adds its sections up, and two of them still counted the findings that the new testOnly line had taken over.

highlights.title: One finding, one line
highlights.description: Enum entries and dead islands kept their testOnly findings in their own count while the testOnly line counted them again, so the headline ran eleven too high on a real project.

highlights.title: The lists were right all along
highlights.description: Only the number in front of the colon was wrong. Every per family list showed the findings it claimed.

highlights.title: A mutant that survived
highlights.description: The first witness only lit one of the two families, so half the fix could be undone with every test still green. Both halves are pinned now.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: A finding kept alive only by its tests is counted on that line and nowhere else.
The enum entry and dead island sections count what they actually list.
